plan.title: Hallmark signature scoring: CD ileum inflamed vs control
plan.analytical_narrative: The 12-sample (6 inflamed vs 6 control) ileal Crohn disease bulk RNA-seq count matrix is first QC'd and normalized with DESeq2 (median-of-ratios, blind VST), explicitly retaining and reporting sample_01 (~4x below median library size) rather than silently dropping it, per the low-depth-sample rule. After a minimal count pre-filter, VST-normalized expression is scored per sample against all 50 MSigDB Hallmark gene sets using UCell's rank-based method — robust to the depth difference because it operates on within-sample gene ranks, not raw magnitudes. The resulting sample x signature score matrix is then tested signature-by-signature between inflamed and control with a t-test (equivalent to limma on scores, appropriate for this simple two-group unpaired design with no batch/covariates), with Benjamini-Hochberg correction applied across the 50 signatures. A sensitivity check re-runs the comparison with sample_01 excluded to confirm no result depends on it. The report consolidates the full score matrix, the per-signature test table, and the QC findings on sample_01, with the reproducibility record (session info, seed, package/collection versions).
